msg: Hi, I'm a certified diver and I'd like to dive from Cartagena next week. My wife has never dived. What can she do while I dive?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Your wife can join the same trip and choose either the **Dive Mini Course**—theory, pool practice, and one reef dive with an instructor—or **snorkeling**. The mini-course is a separate beginner activity and doesn’t require certification.

Online prices include the 10% booking discount.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD (655.000 COP · 727.000 COP)
• Snorkeling Tour: 126 USD · 140 USD (448.000 COP · 497.000 COP)

Would you prefer the mini-course or snorkeling for her?
